mapper.select:
select
from t_std_region a where 1 = 1 and a.region_id = #{regionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, a.region_code AS regionCode, 'region' AS infoType, a.state, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.voltage_level, (select c.dict_note from t_dict_business c where c.col_name = 'voltage_class' and c.dict_code = a.voltage_level) voltageLevelName, a.edge_status FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{regionName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')

SELECT DATA.region_id FROM ( SELECT @ids AS _ids, ( SELECT @ids := GROUP_CONCAT( region_id ) FROM t_std_region WHERE FIND_IN_SET( up_region_id, @ids ) ) AS cids, @l := @l + 1 AS LEVEL FROM t_std_region, ( SELECT @ids := #{regionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, @l := 0 ) b WHERE @ids IS NOT NULL ) ID, t_std_region DATA WHERE FIND_IN_SET( DATA.region_id, ID._ids ) ORDER BY LEVEL,region_id

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, a.region_code AS regionCode, 'region' AS infoType, a.state, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.voltage_level, (select c.dict_note from t_dict_business c where c.col_name = 'voltage_class' and c.dict_code = a.voltage_level) voltageLevelName, a.edge_status FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id
